parsed.why: No criminalisation, self-ID documents, conversion ban, police recording hate incidents with functioning recourse — but a recent trans-specific survey (19% threatened, 8% assaulted in four years) and a 42% rise in reported hate incidents show real street hostility.

Trans-specific six-month detention without trial for 'impersonating the opposite gender', documented custody beatings, arrests based on gender expression, dating-app entrapment of foreign nationals, forced detransition claims and deportation — state-directed targeting of visitors.

No criminalisation, but state raids detaining 100+ with forced exams, beatings and blackmail, a 2023 private-party raid, a 2024 trans murder with inadequate investigation, 77% hostile media and near-zero legal protection: tier-2 targeting with thin recourse.

Death penalty available for same-sex activity, 2024 morality-law surveillance duty, documented systematic pursuit of trans women by security officials, custody abuse, escalating flogging, ICC persecution warrants — state campaign against gender-nonconforming people.

No criminalisation, constitutional self-determination, court-ordered marker recognition, marriage registration and community infrastructure; exposure is social — provincial-city harassment, conversion therapy, and 2026 political hate speech with death threats — but no state-imposed traveller restriction.
